default/30746.htm.text: Cybellin: May the song of the west wind guide you to tranquility. I am pleased to meet you. My name is Cybellin. I am a Dark Elven Mystic studying abyssal magic. I have come to Hunter's Village to collect the rare runestones that were found in Enchanted Valley. I am also involved in the study of Bl…

Q00335_TheSongOfTheHunter/30746-01.html.text: Cybellin: Are you a hunter? Oh yes, of course. Just an aspirant. That's too bad. I need a favor from a real hunter.

Q00335_TheSongOfTheHunter/30746-02.html.text: Cybellin: Ah, a hunter! Oh, how marvelous! I need to ask you a favor. It's related to some very important research I've been performing recently... How about it? Will you assist me?
